description.value: The Dime is a budget-friendly pub and late-night dining spot on Commercial Drive, one of 17 locations in the Warehouse Group chain that blends casual restaurant comfort with a bar and nightlife atmosphere. It sits in the heart of the eclectic 'Drive' neighbourhood, within easy cycling distance of Trout Lake, and the kitchen keeps turning out wings, burgers, and comfort food well into the night. The chain's value-oriented pricing and all-day service make it a practical stop for cyclists exploring East Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 80m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m; stands (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at warehousegroup.ca/location/the-dime-commercial/ confirms an active pub-restaurant at 1565 Commercial Dr with phone +1 604-558-3463, matching the OSM address. Takeout is explicitly listed on the location page ('Take out'). The site encourages cycling ('bike in from Trout Lake') but provides no specific mention of bike racks, washrooms, or water refill. Vegetarian items (Black Bean Burger, Southwest Tortilla Ensalada, General Tao Bowl) appear in menu previews, supporting a value=true for that amenity.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; +1 604-558-3463 sourced from website only.
Customer reviews quoted on the website note the venue does not accept debit — cyclists should be aware cash or credit card may be required.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pub-restaurant confirmed open at the OSM address; a practical food-and-drink stop for cyclists on Commercial Drive.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu previews include Black Bean Burger, Southwest Tortilla Ensalada (plant-based as listed), and General Tao Bowl (mixed vegetables)
